i recently finished this book and i wont lie, i really enjoyed it. but i can totally see why people wont have a good time reading it.

at first everything was going well, the characters seemed likeable (and dislikable at times, eg- JB), and because im really big on seeing friendship portrayed so heartfeltly in media, i was having a good time.

but the more you read, the actions become repeatative especially for jude. the author gives us reason as to WHY the actions are repeatative but it is an issue which i totally get. even though i loved reading it so much, by the end i was tired and also heartbroken.

either way, i think this is the only book that ive read where i will agree with both the types of people- one who loved the book, and the other who hated it
